name: a2a
title: A2A
role: Transport that carries x402 and MPP payments in `SendMessage`, including through the x402 extension.
subset: Agent Card, `SendMessage` with `returnImmediately`, `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask`, paid flow and the x402 extension

exclusions.name: resuming a background task after a restart
exclusions.note: A task the gateway stopped in reads as failed; any payment is in the gateway records.

exclusions.name: task resumption other than an x402 extension payment
file and URL parts (including inline bytes)
artifact types beyond Agent Commerce outcome data
tasks across gateway instances
exclusions.note: Instances with separate receipt stores cannot read, cancel or pay each other's tasks.

conformance.suite: Our tests against the A2A 1.0.1 specification; the A2A TCK has not been run.

gaps.requirement: §3.1: GetTask, ListTasks and CancelTask, which every agent implements
§3.2.2: returnImmediately as well as the blocking default
§3.3.2: validate all input parameters, including tenant and configuration
§7.1: encrypted communication in production; merchant.publicBaseUrl accepts http
